summary: On/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately, with an optional description and the label before or after the track.
whenNotToUse: Choices confirmed with a “Save” button: use Checkbox.
More than two states: use RadioGroup or ToggleGroup.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: start: label on the left (right in RTL) and switch aligned to the end, for settings lists.

accessibility: role="switch" on a native input; the state is announced as on/off.
The thumb position and fill indicate the state, in addition to color; in forced-colors mode it uses system colors.
responsive: With labelPosition="start", a long label wraps without moving the switch.
customization: Colors from color.action.primary and color.border.strong; sizes from the density token.
commonMistakes: Requiring a “Save” after a Switch: it is confusing, use Checkbox.
Labels that describe the state (“On”) instead of the function (“Notifications”).
